fields.label: Entity
fields.description: The legal entity. Same string the warehouse uses for data_area_id, so the ClickHouse join is unaffected.

fields.label: Reporting Currency
fields.description: The currency this group presents its consolidated statements in. Every entity below it is translated directly into it. Required on a group node; on an entity row it is not read.

fields.label: NCI Measurement
fields.description: Partial: NCI at its share of fair-value net assets. Full: NCI at fair value, goodwill includes its share. Under US GAAP set NCI Measurement to full.

fields.label: Intercompany Difference Account
fields.description: Group chart account where this group books intercompany differences: what is left when the two sides of a pair don't match. Blank: only the matched amount is eliminated, and the difference stays on the intercompany accounts.

fields.label: Intercompany Difference Tolerance
fields.description: A booking difference (both sides in one functional currency) up to this amount, at 100% in reporting currency, is within tolerance; above it, over tolerance. An fx difference (sides in different currencies, or translation alone) is shown but never counts against it.

fields.label: Accounting Framework
fields.description: The framework the group consolidates under. It constrains the choices below (US GAAP measures NCI at fair value; IFRS does not amortise goodwill) and labels the journals. Required once the group has a Business Combination; there is no default.

fields.label: Framework Note
fields.description: Which local framework it is. A Local framework may pick any combination below and must say what it is.

fields.label: Goodwill Treatment
fields.description: Impairment only: goodwill stays at cost until impaired. Amortise: a monthly journal Dr Goodwill Amortisation Expense / Cr Goodwill from the acquisition period over the years below, until fully amortised or disposal.

fields.label: Goodwill Amortisation Years
fields.description: Years over which goodwill is amortised on a straight line, when Goodwill Treatment is Amortise.

fields.label: Acquisition Costs Treatment
fields.description: Expense: a Business Combination's cost lines go Dr Acquisition Costs (P&L), outside goodwill. Capitalise: they join the consideration and so the goodwill.

fields.label: Measurement Period
fields.description: 12 months: a submitted Business Combination may be amended within 12 months of the acquisition date, and the journal re-posts in the acquisition period. Off: a submitted deal is final.

fields.label: Bargain Purchase
fields.description: What happens when the consideration is below the group's share of the fair-value net assets. Recognise gain: Cr Bargain Purchase Gain (P&L). Refuse: the deal is refused and named.

fields.label: Acquisition Accounts
fields.description: Published leaves of this group's chart the consolidation journals post to. Each is required only when a deal needs it; the Business Combination names the missing one.

fields.label: Goodwill Account
fields.description: Dr goodwill on acquisition; Cr amortisation or impairment afterwards; released on disposal.

fields.label: Fair Value Adjustment Account
fields.description: Dr/Cr the fair value adjustments to the acquired balances.

fields.label: Investment in Subsidiaries Account
fields.description: Cr the consideration transferred; eliminated against the acquired equity.

fields.label: Non-controlling Interest Account
fields.description: Cr the non-controlling interest's share when less than 100% is acquired, measured per NCI Measurement.

fields.label: Bargain Purchase Gain Account (P&L)
fields.description: Cr the gain when the consideration is below the share of fair-value net assets and Bargain Purchase is Recognise gain.

fields.label: Gain or Loss on Disposal Account (P&L)
fields.description: The balancing line of a Business Disposal: proceeds less the net assets, goodwill and NCI released.

fields.label: Disposal Proceeds Account
fields.description: Dr the proceeds of a Business Disposal.

fields.label: Goodwill Amortisation Expense Account (P&L)
fields.description: Dr the monthly goodwill amortisation when Goodwill Treatment is Amortise.

fields.label: Acquisition Costs Account (P&L)
fields.description: Dr a Business Combination's cost lines when Acquisition Costs Treatment is Expense.
